name: Galaxy A20

Launch.Predecessor: Samsung Galaxy J6, Samsung Galaxy A6, Samsung Galaxy J7 (2018) (for Wide4)
Launch.Successor: Samsung Galaxy A21, Samsung Galaxy A21s, Samsung Galaxy F42 5G (for Wide4)

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 9 "Pie" with One UI 1.1, Current: Android 11 with One UI 3.1
Platform.Chipset: A20e & A20: Samsung Exynos 7 Octa 7884, A20s: Qualcomm Snapdragon 450
Platform.CPU: A20e & A20: Octa-core (2x1.6 GHz Cortex-A73 & 6x1.35 GHz Cortex-A53), A20s: Octa-core (8x1.8 GHz Cortex-A53)
Platform.GPU: A20e & A20: Mali-G71 MP2, A20s: Adreno 506

Cameras.Rear camera: A20e and A20: Primary: 13 MP, f/1.9, 28mm, 1/3.1", 1.12µm, AF, Ultrawide: 5 MP, f/2.2, 12mm, 1/5.0", 1.12µm, LED flash, panorama, HDR, 1080p@30/60fps, A20s: Primary: 13 MP, f/1.8, 28mm, 1/3.1", 1.12µm, AF, Ultrawide: 8 MP, f/2.2, 13mm, 1/4.0", 1.12µm, Depth: 5 MP, f/2.2, LED flash, panorama, HDR, 1080p@30/60fps

Battery.Battery: A20e: Li-Po 3000 mAh, non-removable, A20 & A20s: Li-Po 4000 mAh, non-removable
